0.description: 0px — Flush corners, collapsed gaps, and no stroke. Theme: radius/none, border/none, spacing/pad-none, spacing/gap-none.

2.description: 2px — Emphasis stroke; barely softened corners. Theme: border/emphasis, radius/2xs.

4.description: 4px — Smallest gap and padding; compact radius; micro size. Theme: spacing/gap-2xs, spacing/pad-v-2xs, spacing/pad-h-2xs, radius/xs, size/sm/4.

8.description: 8px — Tight gap; compact padding; default surface radius; compact size. Theme: spacing/gap-xs, spacing/pad-v-xs, spacing/pad-h-xs, radius/sm, size/sm/8.

12.description: 12px — Standard gap and padding; prominent radius; compact icon slot. Theme: spacing/gap-sm, spacing/pad-v-sm, spacing/pad-h-sm, radius/md, size/sm/12.

16.description: 16px — Roomy gap and padding; larger radius; standard icon slot. Theme: spacing/gap-md, spacing/pad-v-md, spacing/pad-h-md, radius/lg, size/md/16.

20.description: 20px — Between roomy and large spacing; compact inline row. Theme: spacing/gap-lg, spacing/pad-v-lg, spacing/pad-h-lg, size/md/20.

24.description: 24px — Large gap and padding; compact control height. Theme: spacing/gap-xl, spacing/pad-v-xl, spacing/pad-h-xl, size/md/24.

28.description: 28px — Between compact and standard control. Theme: size/md/28 (buttongroup, calendar, stepper).

32.description: 32px — Extra-large gap and padding; default control height. Theme: spacing/gap-2xl, spacing/pad-v-2xl, spacing/pad-h-2xl, size/md/32.

36.description: 36px — Table header, sidenav tab, avatar placeholder. Theme: size/md/36.

40.description: 40px — Large control / toolbar row. Theme: size/lg/40.

44.description: 44px — Presence indicator. Core only — no theme size role.

48.description: 48px — Avatar, spinner, toggle track, table body. Theme: size/lg/48.

52.description: 52px — Wide control minimum (input min-width). Theme: size/lg/52.

64.description: 64px — Chrome band: header, searchfield, avatar lg. Theme: size/lg/64.

full.description: True circle. Theme: radius/full. Figma FLOAT cannot store %.
